proposal.observation: Round 2 reproduced round 1 almost exactly: proxy 0.6531, residual 1.5 cm, 21.1% depth NaNs, 11 prompts, x-spacing CV 0.354, fill rate 0.728, and essentially unchanged images. This shows that the bounded Hough changes are inactive under the current fallback path. Upstream geometry is healthy, ring completeness is 1.0, and all semantic classes are present, but segment-size CV remains very high at 1.053 and the labeled-mask artifact shows broad template-size variation. The regular synthetic ring spacing is about 330 pixels, corresponding to roughly 1650 mm at 5 mm/pixel, below the 1800 mm T4 prior.
proposal.failure_mode: SAM template geometry is oversized relative to the observed ring pitch and joint slopes, producing uneven mask areas and crop overlap despite complete ring coverage.
proposal.rationale: The final round removes the empirically inert detection changes and preserves the successful round-1 centreline and radial gate. With stages 1-4 now stable enough, a coordinated SAM adjustment is identifiable: segment width is reduced to the observed axial pitch, K height is modestly reduced to match the narrow K bands visible in the mask, and taper angle is reduced toward the dominant detected oblique slopes. These values remain close to the T4 priors and within the bounded interface, limiting the risk of losing complete ring coverage.
